capture_tool: capture.py in this directory, run once as `python3 -I capture.py https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org .`
notes: the public testnet endpoint ran stellar-rpc 30.0.1 at capture time, not 30.0.0; 30.0.1 changes getLedgers so a cursor at or past the tip returns an empty page and a cursor below the oldest ledger has a shorter message. shapekit serve follows 30.0.1

the endpoint backfills from a data lake, so its validation range starts at ledger 2 (see the start-after-latest and start-missing messages) and requests below its local oldest ledger fail with -32603 from a misconfigured datastore reader (start-before-oldest, cursor-before-oldest). those two cases are kept as captured and the replay server is checked against the stellar-rpc source for them instead
the tip advanced while the capture ran, so every response's latestLedger is at or above range_at_start.latestLedger

responses holding ledgers are summarised by capture.py (key sets, value types, counts, cursor, outer xdr-json structure); error responses are kept whole; response_sha256 is the hash of each raw response body
